This satisfies antecedent of rule 1: someone likes bald eagle => bald eagle chases cat. So bald eagle chases cat.

Thus by rule 5: If someone chases cat then they eat squirrel. So bald eagle eats squirrel.

Thus statement is true.

Thus answer True.
